Approvals in the Portal listed three Pending requests; the review page showed the Contract title and primary Document only; Approve was final (second decision 4xx). After Legal withdrew one request and archived another Contract, their review pages showed "Page not found" and left the list. limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the source-review author; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The lab Help and formal readers serve the article bytes bundled at 067c1646, which predate the reviewed bytes. Steps followed the reviewed bytes against the app; link checks opened every internal link of the reviewed bytes in the bundled formal reader.

The work2 lab is shared with other DOC-030 agents. This walkthrough created records named DOC-030 support ... and put back every organization setting it changed (MCP switches, Read-only, one Contract Document type, archived again). Run history and reruns of reviewer harness faults are in walkthrough.json runNotes.

Signing and Analysis were unconfigured when observed (DocuSign Not connected; AI Provider Not connected; another group had configured and removed a provider stand-in earlier). The Signed Envelope, Executed copy filing, Running…, the Request-context Analysis failure sentence, Retry Request-context Analysis, Unverified values, purple borders, sparkle evidence, Conversion draft preparation and the Request conversion switch names were not produced here; nothing here is live-provider evidence.
Push delivery was not exercised. With browser notification permission granted (full Chromium in new headless mode) the Devices card offered Turn on for this browser; it was not selected.
An Expired API key could not be produced: the shortest organization lifetime is 1 day. The label is in the Status list only.

Connected Clients was seen only in its empty state ("No Client is connected."). No OAuth Client was connected on this local lab, so Disconnect and the Revoke OAuth grant dialog were not exercised; the author listed the same limitation.

Page-could-not-load was produced by blocking the browser request for one Contract read, not by a real outage. Email checks read the lab Mailpit only; spam filtering and morning briefing timing were not exercised.
A Business User created for this walkthrough (Lena Fischer) was used instead of the seeded Jonas Weber, because the three-links-per-address sign-in budget is shared with other agents on this lab.
